hintPrompts: 动手验证：把参数拖到两个极端对比观察
把发现说给 AI 老师听，让它帮你变成结论
先做几组实验再答题，答案就藏在演示里

starterCode:
# 问路指路导航仪
sc = 1   # 场景

hide()
t = "问路"
a1 = "Excuse me, how can I get to the library?"
a2 = "Is there a bank near here? / Where is the nearest bus stop?"
tip = "先说 Excuse me（打扰了）再问——礼貌是通行证"
if sc == 2:
    t = "指路（方向）"
    a1 = "Go along this street and turn left at the second crossing."
    a2 = "Go straight on until you see a hospital, then turn right."
    tip = "along=沿着 / straight=直走 / crossing=十字路口"
if sc == 3:
    t = "指路（位置）"
    a1 = "It's next to the supermarket. / It's across from the park."
    a2 = "It's between the bank and the post office. / It's on your right."
    tip = "next to=旁边 / across from=对面 / between...and=在…之间"
fill_rect(0, 130, 360, 30, "#16a34a")
write(t, 0, 130, "#fff", 13)
fill_rect(0, 74, 360, 48, "#f0fdf4")
write(a1, 0, 74, "#166534", 10)
fill_rect(0, 12, 360, 58, "#fef3c7")
write(a2, 0, 12, "#b45309", 9)
write("词汇：" + tip, -20, -55, "#dc2626", 10)
title: 情景交际：问路与指路

sections.title: 问路句型
sections.body:
【Excuse me, how can I get to + 地点？】
【Is there a + 地点 near here?】
【Where is the nearest + 地点？】
【Could you tell me the way to + 地点？】（更礼貌）
回答不知道：Sorry, I am new here. / Sorry, I do not know.

sections.title: 方位介词
sections.body:
【next to = 旁边 / beside = 在…旁边】
【across from = 对面 / opposite = 对面】
【between...and... = 在…和…之间】
【in front of = 在…前面（外部）/ behind = 在…后面】
【on the left/right = 在左/右边 / at the corner = 在拐角】
方位介词+名词：next to the bank（在银行旁边）。

sections.title: 指路表达
sections.body:
【Go along this street. 沿这条街走】
【Turn left/right at the... 在…处左/右转】
【Go straight on. 直走】
【Take the first turning on the left. 第一个路口左转】
【It is about 5 minute walk. 步行约5分钟】
结束时可以说：You cannot miss it.（你不会错过的）

examples.q: 礼貌地问图书馆怎么走？
steps: 用 how can I get to 句型
Excuse me, how can I get to the library?
或 Could you tell me the way to the library?

mistakes: 问路不说 Excuse me（不礼貌）
across from 和 through 混淆（across 从表面穿过，through 从内部穿过）

exercises.q: Turn left at the second crossing 的意思是？
